title: Endless Sky
tagline: Trade, fight and explore a galaxy of stars in a ship you can afford.
summary: Endless Sky (M. C. Martin and the community, from 2015) is a 2D space trading and combat game. You start with a pilot's licence, a mortgage and a small starship in human space; from there you trade cargo between worlds, take on combat and delivery work, outfit your ship, and fly wherever the hyperlinks go.

This port follows the stable release 0.11.4. The original's own data files drive the galaxy: its 694 star systems, 619 planets, 917 ship definitions and 938 outfits, with their prices, masses, thrust, shields, hull, weapons, trade prices and descriptions. Flight uses the original's frame-by-frame physics, and the star map, landing, trading, shipyard and outfitter use the original's numbers.
The original's sprites, sounds and two bitmap fonts are used. The port runs single-player in the browser; the pilot is saved in your account storage.
